newsitem.title: USA: Staples buys stakes from Kingfisher.
newsitem.headline: Staples buys stakes from Kingfisher.

text.p: Staples Inc said on Wednesday that it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire from Kingfisher Plc its interests in the company's two European joint ventures, Staples UK and Maxi-Papier, for about $50 million and the the assumption of $6 million in bank debt.
As a result of the acquisition, Staples will increase its ownership of Staples UK from 50 percent to 100 percent and its ownership of Maxi-Papier from about 50 percent to about 90 percent.
The remaining 10 percent of Maxi-Papier is held by a group of German investors.
The transactions, which will be accounted for as purchases, are expected to close in May 1997.
Staples UK currently operates 34 stores in the United Kingdom. Maxi-Papier operates 16 stores in Germany.
Staples Inc currently operates 555 office products superstores in over 100 markets across the U.S. and in Canada.
